note: easy2350's parts by package role, read from input/easy2350.net. It has no 0 ohm link between QSPI_SS and the flash, and no footprints for the SS pull-up or a second memory's chip select, so R_SS_LINK, R_SS_PULLUP and R_CS1_LINK are not bound. Decoupling caps by the pin each is nearest along the copper on input/easy2350.kicad_pcb.
